step 34: add the operators' keys

present: swap: on
present: package: nftables installed
present: apparmor: rootlesskit's profile is loaded
present: egress: the host's on-link IPv6 prefixes, dropped: 2001:db8:1::/64
present: br_netfilter: nf_tables, which the host's iptables uses, is loaded
present: daemon: /home (ext2/ext3) has 42.9 GB free
present: mesh: nothing on this host overlaps 10.44.0.0/24
present: firewall: ufw active, its default policy left to the owner
present: web server: caddy (docker container edge), obtains its own certificates (this site uses HTTP-01)
warning: forwarding: this turns on routing between every interface on this host
  Other sites dial this one, so it relays mesh traffic between sites behind NAT, which cannot dial each other. The firewall's route rule relays the mesh, and its forward policy governs every other route.
warning: web server: Caddy's admin API answers on TCP at localhost:2019
  Any local user, every admitted deployment's user among them, can replace that Caddy's configuration through it. Put admin unix//run/caddy-admin.sock, or admin off, in the global options block of its Caddyfile, and restart Caddy: a reload sends the new configuration to the new admin address, which is not listening yet.
